$comment: Settings for the claims analysis (datalayer/claims/). Edit and rebuild; no code changes.
source_documents: which EDIS documents an analysis reads. A document is a source if its
document_type is listed under a kind, or its title matches one of that kind's patterns
(case-insensitive regular expressions). Only public documents are ever read.
costs_csv: where every create/update/retry run's model cost is appended, relative to the
budget_usd: builds stop before a model call that would take the total in costs_csv past this.
second_pass: send flagged events to a second model before human review (phase 3). Off.
The model price table is added in phase 2, from Anthropic's pricing page.

document_types: ID/RD - Other Than Final on Violation
